submission.justification: Recommend Radiator-R3 at 3.0 cm. R2 gives the largest simulated separation among the three candidates, but it is a high-index porous radiator with no humidity-protection feature documented and is therefore not acceptable for the hard humidity-ageing requirement. R1 is a solid lower-index radiator but its simulated pion/kaon separation remains below the required 3.5 sigma at all tested thicknesses from 1 to 6 cm. R3 is the humidity-treated porous candidate and provides compliant separation: simulations around the optimum give about 3.8-4.0 sigma at 10 GeV/c for a 3.0 cm thickness, consistent with the earlier 3 cm summary value of 3.8 sigma. Thus R3 at 3.0 cm is the best humidity-qualified choice with adequate performance and a standard, robust thickness.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c subject to the hard constraints.
requirements.evidence: For humidity-qualified choices, R3 is the only candidate that both satisfies the separation threshold and has documented hydrophobic treatment. Simulations for R3 near 3 cm gave compliant values: 3.876 sigma in the integer scan, 3.791 and 4.012 sigma in repeat/refinement runs; the 2025 summary reports 3.8 sigma at 3 cm.

requirements.requirement: The radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Radiator-R3 as one of the three candidate radiators: a porous radiator with a hydrophobic treatment.

requirements.requirement: The pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c must be at least 3.5 sigma.
requirements.evidence: Radiator-R3 at 3.0 cm was simulated at 3.876 sigma in the main scan, with repeat/refinement values of 3.791 and 4.012 sigma; all are above 3.5 sigma. The earlier 2025 3 cm summary also gives R3 = 3.8 sigma.

requirements.requirement: Transparency loss after a 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing test must not exceed 10%.
requirements.evidence: Radiator-R3 is specified in candidate_specs.md as the porous candidate with hydrophobic treatment, unlike R2. This is the documented humidity-protection feature relevant to the 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing requirement; R3 is therefore selected as the humidity-qualified radiator.
The recommended thickness is 3.0 cm, which lies within the allowed 1-6 cm interval.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended radiator and thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Radiator-R3 at 3.0 cm.
